mealAnalysis.guidance_message: This meal is a small fruit snack composed of grapes and a fig, providing natural sugars with modest fiber. It may raise blood sugar levels in someone with diabetes, though the portion appears limited; it is best to avoid or strictly limit this meal, opting for whole fruit paired with a high-fiber or protein source instead.
mealAnalysis.meal_description: A small bowl containing green grapes and one fresh fig.
